dimensions.name: feasibility
dimensions.findings: Runtime truth is already implemented and tested; remaining work is mostly documentation and decision alignment.
dimensions.recommendations: Update historical Stage 5 wording and keep future class-removal work separate from current cleanup.

dimensions.name: impact
dimensions.findings: Clarification mainly reduces future cleanup churn and keeps readiness narratives aligned with runtime truth.
dimensions.recommendations: Use the retained-interface strategy as the default description of disabled integrations.

dimensions.name: risk
dimensions.findings: Risk comes from reopening blanket noop removal before caller surfaces and types are intentionally simplified away.
dimensions.recommendations: Do not treat explicit disabled adapters as dead code while runtime callers still depend on them.

dimensions.name: complexity
dimensions.findings: Docs alignment is small; real adapter removal would require coordinated refactors across callers, bundle types, and tests.
dimensions.recommendations: Keep the near-term scope to decision and documentation alignment only.

dimensions.name: alignment
dimensions.findings: The retained noop-adapter contract matches the repo's local-first architecture and support-level policy.
dimensions.recommendations: Keep support-level signaling and deterministic fallback behavior as the source of truth.

dimensions.name: maintainability
dimensions.findings: Code and tests are coherent, but historical plan wording still points toward a competing strategy.
dimensions.recommendations: Reconcile the docs so future work does not fork into conflicting interpretations.

decisions.title: Keep disabled adapters as explicit runtime boundaries
decisions.rationale: Current runtime callers and tests still rely on explicit disabled adapter surfaces, especially for graph projection.

decisions.title: Preserve the non-throwing local-first disabled contract
decisions.rationale: Disabled integrations currently return false, empty collections, or status objects and are already covered by tests.

decisions.title: Reconcile historical Stage 5 wording to the shipped retained-interface strategy
decisions.rationale: The remaining inconsistency is documentation drift rather than runtime behavior.

decisions.title: Treat any future noop-class removal as a separate refactor
decisions.rationale: That work is not low-risk cleanup while callers, bundle types, and tests still depend on the boundary.

risk_matrix.description: Blanket noop-adapter removal is reopened before caller and type refactors
risk_matrix.mitigation: Keep retained interfaces until runtime dependencies are explicitly removed.

risk_matrix.description: Historical plan wording remains inconsistent with the shipped contract
risk_matrix.mitigation: Update Stage 5 wording so it matches the current readiness notes and code.
Preserve the current support-level signaling and regression tests.
